summary: Grant County L-4 pole tower built 1933 on the Malheur NF; removal date unknown. No source found describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 20-foot pole tower
facts.status_note: Removed, date unknown (the register says it is unclear when); no source describes the site today

events.note: 20-foot pole tower with L-4 cab, completed 1933; construction was reported as about to begin in July 1932
Creosote-treated tower placed under the existing house, per a Malheur Historical Record entry that calls the site 'Long Creek Mountain'
Registered June 24, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

notes_for_editor: Thin sources. The 1933 build year and L-4 design agree across the register and Forest Lookouts; removal date is unknown in all sources read. The 1948 entry calls the site 'Long Creek Mountain' and may or may not be this lookout; it is included with that caveat. The 1936 survey description is historical; no current survey recovery note was found (the NGS datasheet fetch returned only a listing). No staffing or fire history was found, so none is written. The site today is undescribed in every source read.
